raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Business Analyst / Data Governance Lead – Collibra SME
Sep 2022 – Present
Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) | Client: Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) | Hyderabad, India
Collibra Platform Ownership: Served as primary Collibra SME for RBC's enterprise data governance programme — configured asset models, business glossaries, data quality rules, lineage flows, and operating model governance across 5+ business units.
Lineage Architecture: Architected end-to-end lineage paths, ingestion streams, and metadata dependency maps in Collibra,
cutting critical-data root-cause analysis time by 60%.
Executive Reporting Automation: Designed SQL-driven Power BI dashboards eliminating manual reconciliation, reducing weekly
status report prep from 4 hr 30 min to under 40 min — an 87% saving for senior leadership.
M&A Due Diligence: Led data risk and compliance mapping for a major corporate acquisition; delivered real-time Collibra lineage
maps that informed C-suite decisions and reduced financial exposure.
LeanIX APM Governance: Audited 200+ LeanIX application FactSheets (ownership, lifecycles, architecture) and surfaced
technology bottlenecks on C-level dashboards.
Regulatory Compliance: Authored enterprise data dictionaries, data ownership frameworks, and GDPR/CCPA attribute mapping,
establishing clear accountability across business units.
Business Analysis: Translated BRDs/FRDs into Jira user stories, acceptance criteria, and UAT scripts; achieved 100%
test-scenario coverage on all high-visibility production releases.
Process Optimisation: Modelled As-Is/To-Be process flows in Lucidchart, removing operational friction and improving team
delivery efficiency by 30%.
Stakeholder Governance: Facilitated JAD workshops and glossary standardisation sessions across compliance, technology, and
business units, reducing term duplication in downstream reporting.
Agile Delivery: Drove sprint ceremonies (stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives); maintained Confluence as
single source of truth for requirements and runbooks.
Business Systems Analyst – Collibra & Data Strategy
Nov 2021 – Aug 2022
Integrated Personnel Services (TCS Third-Party Payroll) | Hyderabad, India
• Collibra Data Quality Workflows: Defined and oversaw automated data-quality validation workflows in Collibra for incoming data
pipelines, cutting manual data-cleansing effort by 50%.
PII & Compliance Mapping: Mapped sensitive PII, GDPR, and CCPA data attributes using Collibra asset models, reducing
compliance exposure and enabling automated audit trails.
ERP Requirements: Led cross-functional workshops to capture, draft, and finalise functional and non-functional requirements for
an enterprise-wide ERP implementation.
BI Dashboards: Designed real-time operational Power BI dashboards providing leadership continuous visibility into data
governance compliance health and quality metrics.
Independent Data Governance Consultant
May 2021 – Oct 2021
Self-Employed | Remote
Delivered freelance data reconciliation and governance consulting, optimising client data workflows and reporting accuracy.
Completed advanced certifications in Business Analysis and Power BI data modelling to deepen governance-driven analytics
expertise.
Python Developer & Data Analyst
Jun 2018 – Apr 2021
DigiPub Apex Covantage Pvt Ltd | Visakhapatnam, India
Worked on Python-based backend scripts for data cleaning, ETL parsing, and validation as part of data delivery workflows.
Managed high-volume data delivery for international publishers (Taylor & Francis, Thomson Reuters, National Library of Australia),
consistently meeting and exceeding client SLAs.
Maintained 99% accuracy delivery rating division-wide by authoring daily data-quality checklists and training junior analysts.
Performed data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks across large structured datasets — a foundation that directly led to a
career in Data Governance and Business Analysis.
